participant_1.name: Elif
participant_1.personality: Ambitious and determined, Elif dreams of becoming a lawyer and is passionate about her family's horse-farming background. She is adventurous and desires a life in the city away from her small-town roots.
participant_1.background: i want to be a lawyer. my family has raised horses for generations. i'm from a small town. i was raised on a horse farm. i dream of moving to the city.
